profile.name: 通用VISA消息式仪器
profile.description: 具有串口、GPIB、USB或TCP接口，并通过消息或文本命令进行控制的通用实验室仪器。此类设备常用于实验室中的测量、控制与数据采集，典型对象包括可编程电源、万用表、示波器及各类控制器等。
profile.description_en: A generic laboratory instrument that exposes a message- or text-based control interface over serial, GPIB, USB, or TCP. Such devices are commonly used in labs for measurement, control, and data acquisition, including programmable power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and controllers.

registry.name: National Instruments Message Visa
registry.description: Message Visa Driver是由National Instruments (VISA)生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括初始化、打开。支持Signal, Slot, finalize等操作。
